summary: Structural + visual parity is excellent (all controls present, layout faithful), but the app's CORE feature is broken: clicking Launch throws 'COMException: The handle is invalid' instead of showing the Windows Security credential dialog. In the UWP golden, Launch spawns the credential dialog. This is a behavioral regression affecting all 3 scenarios (shared PickAsync code path, missing IInitializeWithWindow HWND init).

discrepancies.uwp_behaviour: Clicking Launch opens a 'Windows Security' credential dialog window (observed as HWND 2166432 in the golden capture).
discrepancies.winui_behaviour: Clicking Launch writes an error to the Status area: 'System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException: The handle is invalid.' No credential dialog appears.
discrepancies.likely_cause: CredentialPicker.PickAsync on WinUI 3 desktop requires the picker to be initialized with the window handle via IInitializeWithWindow/InitializeWithWindow. The migration did not associate the HWND, so the shell rejects the call with 'handle is invalid'.

discrepancies.uwp_behaviour: Launch invokes the credential picker with message + caption.
discrepancies.winui_behaviour: Same broken PickAsync path (handle-invalid); no dialog. Automated capture recorded no new text token (responded:false) in both UWP and WinUI for this scenario, but the shared code path is the same broken one seen in scenario 1.
discrepancies.likely_cause: Same missing HWND initialization as scenario 1.

discrepancies.uwp_behaviour: Launch invokes the credential picker with the full options set.
discrepancies.winui_behaviour: Same broken PickAsync path; no dialog.
discrepancies.likely_cause: Same missing HWND initialization as scenario 1.

non_issues: All controls (TextBoxes, ComboBoxes, CheckBox, Button, result fields) are present in the WinUI UIA tree — structural coverage 9/9, 10/10, 14/14.
Visual layout, labels, default text, and theming are faithful to the UWP app.
No blank frames; every scenario rendered.
